# Whale B (vendored)

`whale-b.json` holds the view box, the body gradient's axis and the eight
paths of `codewhale-design/whale/svg/whale-b.svg`, with the path data
unchanged. The source file's SHA-256 is
`75bbb9ef40b0bcb3ae2b27dda3d63923fa65a47d203c53ec83bc8ce9fb16a6f1`.
`whale-b-dark.svg`
(`66677a183f32f3a6a8e1884c95ea68c78e2207e2cdf4a2447fbb1b29a08427dd`) has the
same geometry and different fills.

The fills are set in `web/app/styles/home.css` from those two files: the body
gradient `#1e8fd8` to `#0b48bb`, the throat `#dcebf7` and the pleats `#0b48bb`
at 0.78 on the light page; `#3594d8` to `#2b70d5`, `#dcecf8` and `#2b70d5` on
the dark page; the eye `#0b1424` on both.

Re-copy the geometry from its owning source; do not edit it here. The home
page draws this whale once, as a character. It is decorative and is never the
logo.
